sources.entry: ChordDetector - Tiny menu bar app that listens iTunes and Spotify to detect chords of songs!

summary.one_liner: ChordDetector is a tiny macOS menu bar app that listens to iTunes and Spotify to detect the chords of the song currently playing.
summary.what_it_does: The app runs from the macOS menu bar and watches iTunes and Spotify for the track that is playing. It identifies the chords of that song. It keeps a history of up to 20 detected chords. It posts a notification to the macOS Notification Center. It also searches ultimate-guitar to find the top-rated chord sheet for the song. The README is very short and includes no setup or implementation details, and its Demo section has no content.
use_cases: see chords of a song playing in iTunes
see chords of a song playing in Spotify
find chord sheets for the current song
keep a short history of recently detected chords
get chord notifications on a Mac
notable: Detects chords from songs playing in iTunes or Spotify
Keeps a history of up to 20 chords
Sends results to macOS Notification Center
Looks up top-rated chords on ultimate-guitar
caveats: README gives no install or build instructions
README does not state platform requirements beyond macOS menu bar and the named music apps
